top_headline: العنوان : البنك التجاري الدولي -مصر (سى اى بى ) (COMI.CA) - بيان من البنكاسم البنك: البنك التجاري الدولي -مصر (سى اى بى )كود الترقيم الدول - معلومات مباشر
llm_summary:
- CIB, the Commercial International Bank, has topped the list of listed banks on the stock exchange in terms of net income from fees and commissions, reaching 9 billion Egyptian pounds by the end of September 2026.
- The bank has also been awarded the title of 'Best Foreign Exchange Bank in Egypt' for 2027 by Global Finance.
- CIB leads the list of listed banks in terms of total assets, with a value of 1.825 trillion Egyptian pounds as of September 2026.
- The bank has appointed Antar Qandil as the new Head of Technology for the group.
- Omar El-Husseini has been named the new Head of Institutional Banking Services at CIB.
- An investment expert highlights the International Bank's funding as a sign of trust that strengthens Egypt's economy.
- CIB offers a 3-year variable return certificate with a rate of 20.25% to 20.50% on deposits of 1,000 Egyptian pounds or more.
- The bank has also launched a new credit card, the CIB noon card, with various benefits and a competitive interest rate.

These developments showcase CIB's strong performance, recognition in the industry, and its efforts to enhance its services and offerings, which could positively impact the bank's stock and attract investors.
